**About The Team**
 DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We explore robotics and automation to transform last\-mile logistics in the long term. If you have experience applying the latest technology and enhance delivery experiences for millions of users, we want to talk to you.
   

  

 The Drone Delivery team is focused on bringing the dream of fast, efficient, and delightful last\-mile delivery through the air to life. As one of the leaders in this space, we believe in the promise of combining advanced robotics, aviation, and operational innovation to bring this high\-flying technology into our 3\-sided marketplace. We are a team focused on bringing our products and visions to market.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're expanding the drone team! We're looking for engineers passionate about leveraging UAV technology to reimagine logistics. This role focuses on developing and deploying state\-of\-the\-art systems in real\-world environments, transforming bold visions into practical solutions. If you're ready to push the boundaries of innovation, we’d love to connect.
   

  

 This position will report to Engineering Management within DoorDash Labs.

* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest advancements in drone technology and robotics.

* Experience with ROS/ROS 2\.
* Familiarity with sensor integration and data processing techniques.
* Experience with debugging tools and techniques for robotic systems.
* Experience with robotics, drones, and autonomous systems.
